title.value: Embedding Cultural Diversity in Prototype-based Recommender Systems
title.justification: The title is explicitly given at the beginning of the document.
title.quote: Embedding Cultural Diversity in Prototype-based Recommender Systems

analysis.description: The paper addresses popularity bias in recommender systems, specifically targeting cultural overrepresentation, by implementing two enhancements in Prototype-based Matrix Factorization. These enhancements aim to better capture underrepresented items and enforce a uniform distribution of prototypes in the embedding space to promote fairness without sacrificing recommendation quality.
